bio.p1: Born in Poland in 1969, where she currently works. From 1989 to 1995 she studied at the Moscow Higher Institute of Monumental and Decorative Applied Arts. There she graduated with a rector’s distinction in the specialty of conservation of monumental painting, obtaining the qualification of conservation artist and the academic title of Master of Art History.
bio.p2: From 1996 to 1998 she pursued doctoral studies at the Russian State University for the Humanities in Moscow, Faculty of Museology. She works in painting, drawing, printmaking, and illustration. In her creative practice she does not impose uniform boundaries or use standard technologies. She has developed her own technique, combining monotype prints with painting.
bio.p3: Human and private visions of objects and the world are the themes she most willingly explores. Since 1999, Kamila Białkowska-Ismaił has been a member of the graphics section of the Association of Polish Artists and Designers.

exhibitions.intro: Kamila Białkowska-Ismail has taken part in numerous group and solo exhibitions.

list.l1: 1996–1998 annual All-Russian artists’ exhibitions – Art Manege, Moscow.
list.l2: 1996 solo exhibition of painting and graphics at the Polish Cultural Center, Moscow.
list.l3: 2001 group exhibition “Polish Contemporary Art”, Clermont-Ferrand, France.
list.l4: 2002 solo exhibition in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.
list.l5: 2005 solo exhibition “Art Is Not Compulsory”, Warsaw.
list.l7: 2007 solo exhibition “Polish Folktales”, paintings inspired by the works of Bolesław Leśmian, Warsaw.
list.l8: 2008 solo exhibition “Between Angels, Legends Lined with Bare Feet”, Casinos Poland, Warsaw Marriott.
list.l9: 2012 “The Ideal World”, Skwer – Fabryka Trzciny, 60a Krakowskie Przedmieście St., Warsaw.

exhibitions.outro: Her works are held in many private collections in Poland, Russia, Japan, England, France, Germany, the Netherlands and the USA.
